2026下-python-第3章作业/7-17.code:
n = int(input())
weights = [7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 4, 2, 1, 6, 3, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 4, 2]
codes = '10X98765432'
invalid = []
for _ in range(n):
    number = input().strip()
    if len(number) != 18 or any(c not in '0123456789' for c in number[:17]):
        invalid.append(number)
        continue
    total = sum(int(c) * w for c, w in zip(number[:17], weights))
    if number[-1] != codes[total % 11]:
        invalid.append(number)
print('\n'.join(invalid) if invalid else 'All passed')
2026下-python-第3章作业/7-17.explanation: 先确认前 17 位均为数字，再计算加权和，对 11 取模并查表。按输入顺序保存错误号码，全部正确时输出 All passed。
